title: How BDG Media Achieved CPM Lift at Increasing Scale with Magnite’s Prebid Yield Optimization
summary: Learn how BDG Media used Magnite's Prebid Yield Optimization to improve monetization, increase fill rates and drive a 2.7% rCPM lift.
body_markdown: Together, these gains contributed to a 2.7% increase in rCPM, demonstrating how incremental improvements in Prebid performance can translate into stronger monetization – particularly when applied across high volumes of inventory.
